description: Record a problem with these tools for the Ads Uploader team: results that contradict each other, a field that was silently ignored, a saved build display that differs from its preview, or a tool that does not do what its description says. Sends the summary, the expected and actual results and any IDs supplied, not names, emails, ad copy, tokens or other personal data; the server also redacts sensitive text. Returns { reported: true, reference, status: 'queued' }. Each call queues one report; limited to 10 reports per user per hour.
name: ads_report_issue
title: Report Tool Issue
